INSPECTION SPECIFICATION IS-4471 -- PRECISION MACHINED COMPONENT SET, REV C

This specification governs first-article inspection of five components manufactured for the outrigger hydraulic assembly: Shaft A-114, Housing Flange B-22, Drive Pin C-7, Bearing Sleeve D-9, and Locking Collar E-3. All dimensions are inspected per ASME Y14.5 unless otherwise noted.

Shaft A-114 is turned from 4340 alloy bar stock. The finished diameter of Shaft A-114 is 2.500 +/- 0.005 in across the bearing journal. The overall length of Shaft A-114 is 18 3/4 inches end to end. The keyway width of Shaft A-114 is 3/8 inch, cut full length along the journal. After induction hardening, the surface finish of Shaft A-114 is 16 microinches Ra on the journal diameter. The hardness of Shaft A-114 is 58-62 HRC on the hardened journal.

Housing Flange B-22 is a cast and machined aluminum bracket. The bore diameter of Housing Flange B-22 is 1 3/8 inches, reamed to size after casting. The wall thickness of Housing Flange B-22 is 5/16 inch measured at the thinnest boss. The surface finish of Housing Flange B-22 is 63 microinches Ra on the mounting face, which is acceptable for a non-sealing surface.

Drive Pin C-7 is supplied in two heat-treatment states depending on assembly position. When annealed for the pilot-hole fit, the hardness of Drive Pin C-7 is 20-25 HRC. When hardened for the load-bearing position, the hardness of Drive Pin C-7 is 58-62 HRC. The diameter of Drive Pin C-7 is 1/4 inch +/- 0.001 in, ground to size after heat treatment.

Bearing Sleeve D-9 is a bronze bushing pressed into the housing bore. The bore diameter of Bearing Sleeve D-9 is 7/8 inch, honed after pressing. The overall length of Bearing Sleeve D-9 is 1 1/4 inches. The hardness of Bearing Sleeve D-9 is 22-26 HRC, well below the shaft hardness to avoid galling.

Locking Collar E-3 threads onto the shaft end to retain the bearing stack. The thread of Locking Collar E-3 is 1/4-20 UNC, class 2A fit. The diameter of Locking Collar E-3 is 7/16 inch across the flats. The surface finish of Locking Collar E-3 is 0.4 micrometres Ra on the bearing face, roughly equivalent in appearance to a ground finish.

All plus-or-minus tolerances shown above are bilateral unless a unilateral limit is called out separately on the drawing. Surface finish call-outs use Ra unless RMS is stated.
